name: Vinci Eval Integrity
qualification_rule: Any FAIL or UNVERIFIED check blocks qualified-evaluator language for model selection, optimization, release, or product claims.

checks.name: Contract clarity
requires: scored edge cases stated in contract

checks.name: Runtime/certification separation
requires: visible runtime channel used only for repair/retry
protected score channel not exposed to policy

checks.name: Estimand, censoring, and retention integrity
requires: adaptive sampling excluded from pooled yield

checks.name: Exact-procedure power and independent requalification
requires: power simulated against full decision procedure
post-repair population built by a different method
